description: Server-side JavaScript code for a database visualizer API using Express.js, supporting multiple database types (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB). It loads environment variables, configures database adapters, tests connections, and exposes REST API endpoints for database info, tables, and data retrieval.

classes.name: DatabaseAdapter
classes.description: Base class for database adapters, providing interface methods for testing connection, retrieving tables, and data.

classes.name: SQLAdapter
classes.description: Abstract class extending DatabaseAdapter, for SQL-based databases, implementing execute, getTables, getData, and related methods.

classes.name: PostgresAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for PostgreSQL, implements execute, getTableQuery, getDataQuery.

classes.name: MySQLAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MySQL, implements execute, getTableQuery, getDataQuery.

classes.name: SQLiteAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for SQLite, implements execute, getTableQuery, getDataQuery, and testConnection.

classes.name: MongoDBAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MongoDB, implements withClient, testConnection, getTables, getData.

methods.name: loadEnvFiles
methods.description: Loads environment variables from .env files for different databases.

methods.name: testConnections
methods.description: Tests database connections for configured adapters and returns list of available databases.

methods.name: handleApiRequest
methods.description: Generic handler for API requests, executes operation on specified database adapter.
